attributes.name: Mark Carney
attributes.blurb: Voted to lead Canada's Liberal Party; International banker, former Bank of Canada, Bank of England governor
attributes.summary: Mark Carney was chosen to lead Canada's Liberal Party in a crucial leadership race in Match 9 2025 amid threats from President Trump. He is expected to quickly call a federal election.  He will face off with Pierre Poilievre, the leader of the Conservative Party.
